final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM status_counts), above_average AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS avg_share_pct FROM shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - avg_share_pct) AS average_amount_above_average_pct FROM above_average WHERE share_pct > avg_share_pct
